title: Japan: Kyushu, Okinawa, Hokkaido, Sendai, Hiroshima/Okayama coverage gap
description: Coverage-gap pass (2026-10-06) for Japanese prefectures where Bouldeer is thin: Kyushu (Fukuoka, Saga, Nagasaki, Kumamoto, Oita, Miyazaki, Kagoshima), Okinawa, Hokkaido, Miyagi (Sendai), Hiroshima and Okayama. Open indoor bouldering gyms confirmed on their own site or official SNS.
